This script creates the Parinandi (2020) cascade plot.

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(NetworkInference)
library(haven)

set.seed(1333)

# PC
# parinandi <- read_dta("C:/Users/ndhem/Documents/vscode_projects/Pred_Diffusion_2025/data/parinandi2020.dta")
# Laptop
parinandi <- read_dta("C:/Users/ndhem/Documents/vscode_projects/Pred-Diffusion-2025/data/parinandi2020.dta")

# Group by state, year, policy
# Get year policy was adopted for each state/policy
cascade_long <- group_by(parinandi, state, featurenumber) %>%
  filter(oneemulation == 1) %>%
  summarise(oneemulation = min(year)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create cascades 
cascades <- as_cascade_long(cascade_long, cascade_node_name = 'state', event_time = 'oneemulation', cascade_id = 'featurenumber')

# Sample colnames
names <- unique(cascade_long$featurenumber)
selection <- sample(names, 10)
plot(cascades, label_nodes = FALSE, selection = selection)

```

if (!requireNamespace("neha", quietly = TRUE)){
  if (!requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE)){

  }
  devtools::install_github("desmarais-lab/neha")
  library(neha)

library(neha)

betas <- c(
  adagovideology   =  0.011231,
  citizenideology  =  0.024820,
  medianivoteshare = -0.021950,
  partydecline     =  0.306356,
  squirescore      =  0.128485,
  incunemp         =  0.036945,
  pctpercapincome  = -0.019971,
  percenturban     =  0.033201,
  ugovd            = -0.034244,
  percentfossilprod=  0.002523,
  renergyprice11   =  0.011837,
  deregulated      =  0.723416,
  geoneighborlag   =  1.121361,
  ideoneighborlag  = -1.634820,
  premulation1     = -57.633130,
  year             = -0.003629,
  featureyear      =  0.162005
)

parinandi <- as.data.frame(parinandi)

# sim_data <- simulate_neha_discrete(parinandi, node = "state", time = "year", beta = betas, gamma = 0)

simulate_neha_discrete_nonet <- function(x, node, time, beta) {
  times <- sort(unique(x[[time]]))
  nodes <- sort(unique(x[[node]]))
  
  # covariate linear predictor
  x_linear_predictor <- as.matrix(x[, row.names(beta), drop = FALSE]) %*% beta
  
  event_times <- rep(NA, length(nodes))
  event <- rep(NA, nrow(x))
  
  for (t in times) {
    nodes_at_risk <- nodes[is.na(event_times)]
    
    for (n in nodes_at_risk) {
      idx <- which(x[[time]] == t & x[[node]] == n)
      xlp_nt <- x_linear_predictor[idx]
      
      # no network effects
      linear_predictor <- xlp_nt
      
      pr_nt <- 1 / (1 + exp(-linear_predictor))
      event_nt <- as.integer(pr_nt > runif(1))
      
      event[idx] <- 0
      if (event_nt == 1) {
        event_times[which(nodes == n)] <- t
        event[idx] <- 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  x <- data.frame(x, event, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  data.frame(na.omit(x), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

simulate_neha_discrete_nonet(parinandi, node = "state", time = "year", beta = betas)
